result.title: Long-form Video-to-Text Summarization using Recursive Language Models
result.summary: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向长视频到文本摘要的递归视频语言摘要模型 RVLSM：用语义时序分解把长视频按语义边界切成连贯片段，交给 VideoLLM 子模型和外部工具做分块推理，并以自适应多模态工具调用路由按需启用动作识别、OCR、ASR、目标检测等模块；在 VideoXum 和 MixTyVSum 上超过零样本 VideoLLM 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属长视频摘要应用而非 latent 推理研究，但其「递归分段＋按需路由外部工具」的层级处理与证据获取机制，可能为 LVR 的分段状态更新、证据筛选与动态计算分配提供方法线索，可供核查其 chunk 间信息传递与路由决策的设计。
